Executive Summary

Make every channel more specific, useful, and discoverable.

ButterflyMX already has strong brand assets and a solid LinkedIn foundation. The next opportunity is to make paid and organic social more audience-specific, more responsive to real customer language, and more visible in the public conversations that shape buying decisions.

1
Audience-specific Meta creativeBuild creative around the distinct pressures of owners, property managers, HOA/condo boards, and resident-facing use cases.
2
Transparent Reddit participationPrioritize helpfulness, disclosure, and response speed instead of covert promotion.
3
Voice-of-customer intelligenceTurn community language, objections, complaints, and comparison behavior into better messaging and creative.
4
Search + AI visibilityTreat Reddit and community content as part of the brand's discoverability layer, not only as social media.
Data basis: the Reddit benchmarks below come from Octolens' 2026 B2B SaaS study analyzing 522M+ Reddit mentions across 500K+ subreddits and 300K+ SaaS & Tech brands.

Meta Creative Opportunity

The current proposal correctly identifies that broad, product-first creative leaves performance on the table. ButterflyMX serves several buyer groups with different pressures: budget, staffing, resident experience, security, package management, and access operations.

SHIFT: from “Here is our platform” to “Here is the exact operational headache we remove for you.”

Reddit & Reputation Opportunity

Property-management communities discuss vendors, access control, resident pain points, and replacements before many prospects ever reach a brand page. The opportunity is credible, disclosed participation and fast monitoring.

SHIFT: from reactive reputation management to an always-on system for discovery, helpful response, and insight capture.

Sources: ButterflyMX partner resources; original ButterflyMX strategic proposal.

3
Discovery

Reddit Is a High-Intent Research Channel

23%of Reddit B2B discussions show active buying intent
+230%growth YoY for “Alternative to X” threads
47average comments per comparison thread
3.2xmore engagement on competitor-frustration threads

Why this matters for ButterflyMX

Property technology buyers often research problems before they research brands: intercom replacement, access control, package theft, resident experience, vendor comparisons, and implementation concerns.

Recommendation and comparison threads are valuable because the buyer is already describing the need, constraints, and alternatives in their own language.

Monitor competitor names and problem phrases, then prioritize high-intent threads where a genuinely useful response can add context.

Recommended Reddit operating model

1
MonitorTrack ButterflyMX, competitors, product categories, pain points, and buying-signal phrases.
2
TriageRank opportunities by intent, relevance, thread velocity, and reputational risk.
3
RespondUse disclosed brand/employee accounts. Lead with expertise; mention ButterflyMX only when relevant.
4
CaptureLog objections, competitor weaknesses, feature requests, and exact customer language.
5
RecycleFeed insights into Meta hooks, landing-page copy, FAQs, content, and product feedback.

Source: Octolens, How B2B SaaS Wins on Reddit (2026), comparison and product-research findings.

5
AI Visibility

Community Content Compounds Across Search + AI

4.7xmore likely for Reddit threads to appear in AI-generated responses than blog posts
34%ChatGPT responses citing “Reddit” in the Octolens B2B tool sample
200+average upvotes for AI-cited threads
89%high-engagement recommendation threads appearing on Google page one in the study

Why reputation now travels further

Public community discussions can surface through Google and increasingly influence AI-assisted research. A useful thread can create visibility well beyond Reddit, while a persistent negative or misleading narrative can also compound.

Treat community reputation as an operating system: monitor, respond, document, and turn recurring questions into durable public answers.

6
Execution

90-Day Rollout

Days 1–30

Foundation

  • Audit paid creative by persona and funnel stage
  • Set Reddit keyword and competitor monitoring taxonomy
  • Define disclosure rules, escalation policy, and response voice
  • Create baseline reporting dashboard
Days 31–60

Activation

  • Launch persona-specific Meta test batches
  • Begin disclosed participation in priority communities
  • Respond to Priority A/B threads using SLA
  • Tag community insights by pain point, objection, and competitor
Days 61–90

Optimization

  • Scale winning creative combinations
  • Publish durable content from recurring questions
  • Create monthly reputation + VOC briefing
  • Refine budget and content allocation from assisted-conversion data
Operating principle: the goal is not to “win Reddit” or generate more posts. The goal is to build a repeatable system that turns community attention into faster market intelligence, better creative, stronger public trust, and more qualified demand.
7
Measurement

How Success Will Be Measured

4 layersmeasure attention, trust, demand, and learning — not follower growth in isolation

Attention

CTR / thumb-stop rate by persona · Reddit mention volume + thread velocity · share of voice in relevant conversations.

Trust

Helpful-response engagement · sentiment and complaint resolution · ratio of positive / neutral / negative branded mentions.

Demand

Qualified lead conversion by creative angle · assisted conversions from social/community touchpoints · high-intent thread referrals.

Learning

New objections / pains identified · winning customer-language patterns · product or content ideas sourced from community feedback.
